flawless: You could not touch me. Nothing can. I am only a rumour that bites.
Your spells had nothing to target. I was never really there.
solid: You struck at an illusion and hit me anyway. Remarkable, for a mortal.
Time folds strangely in the rift. You caught one of its creases.
close: My edges are fraying. You very nearly unmade a dream.
I am flickering... for an illusion, that was far too real.
